mapper.select: select u.userid as userId, u.small_icon as photoUrl, u.nick_name as nickName, u.phone as phone, au.bring_chip as oriCoins, au.present_chip as nowCoins, au.status as status from T_USER u, T_ACTIVITY_USER au where au.activity_id=#{activityId} and au.userid=u.userid and au.status=1

select u.userid as userId, u.small_icon as photoUrl, u.nick_name as nickName, u.phone as phone, au.bring_chip as oriCoins, au.present_chip as nowCoins, au.status as status from T_USER u, T_ACTIVITY_USER au where au.activity_id=#{activityId} and au.userid=u.userid
SELECT userid FROM t_activity_user WHERE activity_id = #{activityId}
SELECT DISTINCT tc.userid FROM t_activity_user tau JOIN t_test_config tc on tau.userid=tc.userid WHERE activity_id=#{gameActivityId} AND tc.agentId=88888888 GROUP BY tc.userid;
SELECT is_gold FROM t_game where level=#{level}
